regions.label: DelayNestedLoops
regions.evidence: Entry X is delay count; nested Y decrement and X countdown loops terminate in RTS. Called by coherent fade helper $818B/$820C; accumulator unaffected. See analysis/evidence/residual-listing.json. Structural classification only; no observed/natural execution claim.

regions.label: DisableNmiPreserveA
regions.evidence: Balanced PHA/PLA wrapper clears bit7 of PPUCTRL shadow $00 and $2000. Called by $818B, paired with existing enable helper. See analysis/evidence/residual-listing.json. Structural classification only; no observed/natural execution claim.

regions.label: SetRenderingMaskHelpers
regions.evidence: Four independent JSR $8122 wait wrappers clear/set background or sprite mask bits in PPUMASK shadow $01 and RTS. Called by connected helpers $818B/$819A, balanced call contracts and exact RTS boundaries. See analysis/evidence/residual-listing.json. Structural classification only; no observed/natural execution claim.

regions.label: PaletteFadeHelpers
regions.evidence: Coherent enable/disable wrappers and two 16-color fade loops: stage palette at $0580, upload through established $84B4 command contract to PPU $3F00, increment/decrement luminance by $10 with 8 counted iterations and balanced stack. Exact routine ends at RTS and next established routine $825C. Calling precondition palette pointer $7A/$7B for fade-in; natural caller unresolved. See analysis/evidence/residual-listing.json. Structural classification only; no observed/natural execution claim.

regions.label: SetPpuIncrement32
regions.evidence: PPUCTRL bit2 setter and shadow update, matching existing opposite increment helper, sets $0B=2 then RTS; independent PPU register contract. See analysis/evidence/residual-listing.json. Structural classification only; no observed/natural execution claim.

regions.label: SetPpuAddressFromCoordinates
regions.evidence: A low-nibble nametable parameter, X column, Y row. Preserves Y in $74, uses established nametable address lookup $85C9/$85CA, writes $2006 high/low and calls $8278 latch reset. Bounds test row31 distinguishes nametable base handling; exact RTS boundary and register/data flow support static code. See analysis/evidence/residual-listing.json. Structural classification only; no observed/natural execution claim.

regions.label: SelectFirstNametable
regions.evidence: Balanced PHA/PLA wrapper writes PPU address $2000 and invokes existing $8278 latch routine; terminates RTS before known adjacent routine. See analysis/evidence/residual-listing.json. Structural classification only; no observed/natural execution claim.

regions.label: CopyFourPagesToPpu
regions.evidence: A provides PPU high address; write low zero then copy four 256-byte pages via ($7A),Y to $2007, incrementing pointer high. X/Y counted loops and RTS independently establish code and bounds; natural entry unresolved. See analysis/evidence/residual-listing.json. Structural classification only; no observed/natural execution claim.

regions.label: TestMusicActive
regions.evidence: SEC; LDA0; SBC $05C0; RTS returns condition based on existing music-active state. Independent sound-driver contract, exact boundary before known $8625 function. See analysis/evidence/residual-listing.json. Structural classification only; no observed/natural execution claim.

regions.label: ResumeMusic
regions.evidence: Set existing music-active flag $05C0 to1 and RTS, adjacent matching stop routine and sound driver state. See analysis/evidence/residual-listing.json. Structural classification only; no observed/natural execution claim.

regions.label: RenderTextWithWideMode
regions.evidence: Alternate entry PHA and saves X/Y to same $0656/$0657 coordinates used by adjacent text renderer; sets $72=2 then falls into existing common renderer. Matching stacked-A consumer/return contract establishes prefix. See analysis/evidence/residual-listing.json. Structural classification only; no observed/natural execution claim.

regions.label: CheckOrthogonalGridNeighbors
regions.evidence: Input grid center $CC/$CD, test four orthogonal cells through existing $B06A predicate. regions.label: CheckCurrentGridCell

regions.label: MusicPattern0
